name: velocut
description: Edit video and direct 3D scenes in Velocut. Starts a prebuilt local Studio automatically.

interface.longDescription:
Edit timelines, generate media, build editable 3D scenes and inspect rendered results with Codex. The matching prebuilt Studio starts on first use.

Try creating a first cut from your clips, building a scene with warm lighting, or reviewing a camera composition.

Requires Node.js 22.6+ and npm. No source checkout or separate reasoning-model API key.
